correctness.rationale: The general all-traces criterion is proven by extension of forests within connected complements. In a wheel, planar duality converts complement-connectivity to dual forest status. The two exact cyclic run restrictions are captured by 16 binary states, with exactly two monochromatic false-positive indicator words and two states apiece. Symbolic exact determinant det(I-tT)=1-(1+4z)t+(2z+4z²)t²-z²t³ produces the unrestricted polynomial recurrence by the trace/determinant identity. Independent direct Python and C++17 checks enumerate every edge subset for \(3\le m\le9\) and confirm all coefficients; symbolic determinant check proves its polynomial identity, not just specializations. The size-m optimizer count yields VC and Littlestone dimensions m. Explicit five-rim facet certificate plus exhaustive finite enumeration establishes 5 size-four and 60 size-five facets. The nonstandard central proof is self-contained; finite checks alone are not used to infer all orders.

value.rationale: For a natural graph concept class, the previously unlocated complete coefficient-by-coefficient support polynomial has exact degree-three order recurrence and rational bivariate generating function, yielding explicit asymptotic growth and a nonpure shattering boundary. The algebraic simplification from a 16-state automaton to a cubic is structural, and the joint primal/dual forest counts are not obtainable by the prior top-degree result alone. The full invariant is motivated by shattered supports and simultaneous graphic/cographic constraints; no broader downstream theorem is alleged.
